tasks.label: masked-env-file-audit
tasks.command: $paths = @('server\.env','server\.env.local','server\.env.example'); foreach ($path in $paths) { if (Test-Path $path) { $keys = Get-Content $path | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*=' } | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '=',2)[0].Trim() }; Write-Output "$path exists; keys=$($keys -join ',')"; if ($path -ne 'server\.env.example') { Get-Content $path | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*(DATABASE_URL|DIRECT_URL)\s*=' } | ForEach-Object { $key = ($_ -split '=',2)[0].Trim(); $raw = ($_ -split '=',2)[1].Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'"); if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)) { Write-Output "$key is empty" } else { try { $uri = [System.Uri]$raw; Write-Output "$key present; scheme=$($uri.Scheme); host=$($uri.Host); database-path=$($uri.AbsolutePath)" } catch { Write-Output "$key present but not a valid URL" } } } } } else { Write-Output "$path is missing" } }

tasks.command: foreach ($path in @('server\.env.local','server\.env')) { if (!(Test-Path $path)) { Write-Output ($path + ': missing'); continue }; $lines = Get-Content $path; $keyLine = $lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*GEMINI_API_KEY\s*=' } | Select-Object -First 1; $modelLine = $lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*GEMINI_MODEL\s*=' } | Select-Object -First 1; $keyStatus = 'missing'; if ($keyLine) { $keyValue = ($keyLine -replace '^\s*GEMINI_API_KEY\s*=\s*','').Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'"); if ($keyValue) { if ($keyValue -match '(?i)replace[-_ ]?with|your[_ -]?key|placeholder') { $keyStatus = 'placeholder' } else { $keyStatus = 'configured' } } }; $modelValue='(default)'; if ($modelLine) { $modelValue = ($modelLine -replace '^\s*GEMINI_MODEL\s*=\s*','').Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'") }; Write-Output ($path + ': key=' + $keyStatus + '; model=' + $modelValue) }

tasks.label: check-gemini-env-status
tasks.command: $files = @('server\.env.local','server\.env'); foreach ($p in $files) { if (!(Test-Path $p)) { Write-Output ($p + ': missing'); continue }; $keyLine = Select-String -Path $p -Pattern '^\s*GEMINI_API_KEY\s*=' | Select-Object -First 1; $modelLine = Select-String -Path $p -Pattern '^\s*GEMINI_MODEL\s*=' | Select-Object -First 1; $status = 'missing'; if ($keyLine) { if ($keyLine.Line -match 'replace-with-your-key|placeholder') { $status = 'placeholder' } elseif ($keyLine.Line.Length -gt 16) { $status = 'configured' } }; $model = '(default)'; if ($modelLine) { $model = $modelLine.Line -replace '^\s*GEMINI_MODEL\s*=\s*',''; $model = $model.Trim([char]34) }; Write-Output ($p + ': key=' + $status + '; model=' + $model) }

tasks.label: validate-gemini-service
tasks.command: npm run build:server; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm --workspace server run lint

tasks.label: test-gemini-calls-mocked-provider
tasks.command: npm --workspace server test -- src/app.controller.spec.ts

tasks.label: inspect-running-api-instance
tasks.command: $l = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$l) { Write-Output 'Port 3001: no listener'; exit 1 }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -eq $l.OwningProcess -or $_.ParentProcessId -eq $l.OwningProcess } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('PID=' + $_.ProcessId + '; Parent=' + $_.ParentProcessId + '; Command=' + $_.CommandLine) }

tasks.label: inspect-api-parent
tasks.command: $l = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; $pidValue = $l.OwningProcess; $child = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -eq $pidValue } | Select-Object -First 1; $parent = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -eq $child.ParentProcessId } | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Output ('API PID=' + $child.ProcessId + '; ' + $child.CommandLine); if ($parent) { Write-Output ('Parent PID=' + $parent.ProcessId + '; ' + $parent.CommandLine) }

tasks.label: restart-api-current-gemini-model
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Id 26736 -ErrorAction Stop; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($listener) { Write-Output 'Port 3001 is still occupied; not starting a second API instance.'; exit 1 }; Write-Output 'Stopped verified TeamLift API process on port 3001.'

tasks.label: start-api-model-2-5
tasks.command: npm run dev:server

tasks.label: verify-live-gemini-generation
tasks.command: $dashboard = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/api/dashboard' -TimeoutSec 15; $slot = $dashboard.slots | Where-Object { $_.startAt -gt (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') } | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$slot) { Write-Output 'No future slot exists for a live provider check.'; exit 2 }; $body = @{ slotId = $slot.id; firstName = 'Diagnostic' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $result = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/api/ai/confirmation' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 45; Write-Output ('Gemini confirmation source: ' + $result.source); Write-Output ('Generated message nonempty: ' + [bool]$result.message); if ($result.source -ne 'gemini') { exit 1 }

tasks.label: test-and-build-current-gemini
tasks.command: npm --workspace server test -- src/app.controller.spec.ts; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm run build:server; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm --workspace server run lint

tasks.label: inspect-listening-api-owner
tasks.command: $l = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$l) { Write-Output 'No API listener'; exit 1 }; $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -eq $l.OwningProcess } | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Output ('PID=' + $l.OwningProcess + '; Command=' + $p.CommandLine)

tasks.label: list-bookingapp-node-processes
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'bookingApp' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('PID=' + $_.ProcessId + '; Parent=' + $_.ParentProcessId + '; Command=' + $_.CommandLine) }

tasks.label: clear-duplicate-app-api-watchers
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Id 2596,29096,11544,5604 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($listener) { Write-Output ('Port 3001 remains held by PID ' + $listener[0].OwningProcess); exit 1 }; Write-Output 'Stopped only the identified TeamLift Nest/API processes; port 3001 is free.'

tasks.label: confirm-api-port-free
tasks.command: $l = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($l) { Write-Output ('Port 3001 held by PID ' + $l.OwningProcess); exit 1 } else { Write-Output 'Port 3001 is free.' }

tasks.label: start-single-api-watcher
tasks.command: npm run dev:server

tasks.label: test-real-gemini-3-8-response
tasks.command: $dashboard = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/api/dashboard' -TimeoutSec 15; $slot = $dashboard.slots | Where-Object { $_.startAt -gt (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') } | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$slot) { Write-Output 'No future slot exists for live provider check.'; exit 2 }; $body = @{ slotId = $slot.id; firstName = 'Diagnostic' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $result = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/api/ai/confirmation' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 45; Write-Output ('Source=' + $result.source + '; nonempty=' + [bool]$result.message); if ($result.source -ne 'gemini') { exit 1 }

tasks.label: retry-live-gemini-provider
tasks.command: $dashboard = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/api/dashboard' -TimeoutSec 15; $slot = $dashboard.slots | Where-Object { $_.startAt -gt (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') } | Select-Object -First 1; $body = @{ slotId = $slot.id; firstName = 'Diagnostic' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; 1..3 | ForEach-Object { $result = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/api/ai/confirmation' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 45; Write-Output ('attempt ' + $_ + ': ' + $result.source); if ($result.source -eq 'fallback' -and $_ -lt 3) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 3 } }
